briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3.5 escalate frontier race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with multiple frontier releases this month. Major labs push capability boundaries while regulatory scrutiny lags deployment speed.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with multimodal reasoning; Anthropic launched Claude 4 Opus; Google deployed Gemini 3.5; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B; xAI and DeepSeek announced competitive updates. Reasoning benchmarks show rapid gains.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, IoT and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announced $40B combined data center expansions; NVIDIA H200 shipments reached 500k units; TSMC 2nm AI chip production ramped ahead of schedule.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI-level system emerge from a closed lab or open-source collaboration by 2028?
